composition: Panel sequences occupy the reading column. About / team / support are separate rooms reached from a tiny index (intro / the legend / the team / support us). Bright flat fields, not a dark shell.
typography: Display type is chunky, friendly, sometimes broken across lines ('yes the legend, / is ponpon!'). Body is simple. Language codes EN | FR sit as equal glyphs.
palette: Saturated character colors on light grounds. Not a two-stop luxury pair. Local colors follow the cast.
geometry: Comic panels with uneven sizes. Gutters are generous. About pages use oversized broken headlines more than grids.
navigation: Short textual index plus scroll through the episode. No hamburger of case studies.
hero: The first panel / title card of the episode. 'Scroll down' is allowed because the object is a comic.
motion: Loops inside panels, GSAP-authored takes, WebGL where a gag needs it. Motion is acting, not transitions-between-routes.
interaction: Hover/tap triggers gags. Some panels are toys. Support CTAs stay in voice.
imagery: 100% original illustration. No photography, no 3D product.
materials: Flat fill, bold outline, risograph-adjacent cheer. No glass, no film grain.
spatial_rhythm: Episode reading is the long rhythm. About pages are short and loud.
responsive: Designed to be read on phone. Panels stack. Gags that need hover get tap equivalents.
signature_motif: Diegetic panel toys inside a bilingual webcomic
